clue.text: Female spirit: woman steeped in evil

explanation.definitionFit: In Irish folklore a wailing ghost woman foretells a death in the family.

clue.text: Worker able to receive new state payment?

explanation.definitionFit: Welfare money paid by the government in Britain is called a social security allowance of this kind.

clue.text: Not too much attached to bars?

definitions.meaning: the Italian phrase translates literally as moderately, without excess
a tempo marking written above bars of music, such as allegro with this qualifier

explanation.surface: Someone advises moderation about time spent in pubs.
explanation.definitionFit: Italian for not overly, used by composers as a tempo qualifier over a passage of musical bars.

clue.text: Very fashionable -in Barcelona, the place to stay

parts.note: hot means very fashionable, as in the hottest new thing
el is the Spanish word for the

explanation.surface: A traveller says the trendiest lodging in Barcelona is where to stay.

clue.text: Played first card after trump annoyed

clue.text: Place of origin involving a second home, say

parts.note: a root is the place something originates from

clue.text: Gift horse redirected looking to the future

clue.text: Drinks last of wine -that's a mistake

explanation.definitionFit: A slip or momentary failure of concentration is an error.

clue.text: Late with camera move, 18 19 showing no response to stimulus

parts.note: late means dead, as in the late king
to pan is to swing a camera across a scene

clue.text: Group of nine — and nobody on time!

parts.note: none means nobody

clue.text: Religious books chap repaired with love, pray

clue.text: Anger in course of plane trip: non-electric illumination?

parts.note: a flight is a journey by plane
ire means anger

explanation.surface: A passenger loses their temper during an air journey with the cabin lights off.
explanation.definitionFit: Glow from a hearth or burning logs lights a room without electricity.

clue.text: Followers who can be counted on to get you out

definitions.text: Followers who can be counted on to get you out

parts.words: Followers who can be counted on to get you out
parts.note: followers are meek flock animals, and counting them is the classic aid to falling asleep, knocking you out

explanation.definitionFit: Flock animals are a byword for conformist followers and are counted by insomniacs.

clue.text: Best diamonds: endless subject of discussion

parts.note: top means best

indicators.note: endless means the final letter is cut off the word

parts.note: ice is slang for diamonds

clue.text: Singer in church is tucking into beer; losing head

losing head means the first letter is removed

explanation.walkthrough: 'Singer in church' looks like the whole definition, but 'in' is only a link and 'church' gives the opening letters; 'losing head' and 'tucking into' work on the beer.

clue.text: Bright colour that possibly has me reeling

indicators.note: possibly says the letters may be arranged another way

explanation.surface: A dazzling shade makes the speaker dizzy.

clue.text: To be deceptive is very serious in first appearance in magistrates' court

indicators.note: one piece is placed inside the other
the first appearance of a word is its opening letter

parts.note: dire means very serious

explanation.definitionFit: To mislead or point someone the wrong way is to deceive.

clue.text: I simpered awkwardly, across revealing skin

explanation.surface: Someone smiles coyly and clumsily, showing a little skin.

clue.text: Nose? Favouring superior involves introduction of coloured one!

parts.note: pro means in favour of

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

clue.text: Do well writing about power? Right

parts.note: prose is ordinary written language

explanation.definitionFit: To thrive or flourish financially is to succeed.

clue.text: Scores in more than one Test

tests or attempts, as a trial is a test

clue.text: Unfortunately staying very dark

indicators.note: unfortunately suggests things have gone awry, so the letters are disordered

clue.text: Prize donor, withholding new one, points to footnotes

I is the Roman numeral one

clue.text: Artist showing some modern stuff

clue.text: Smart, pocketing Queen in any tricky behaviour

clue.text: Crisis is not repeated — power's invigorating

parts.note: taken as written

clue.text: Risk heading off for stroll

clue.text: Traitor's prime motive?

explanation.surface: Someone asks what drives a turncoat most of all.
